requirements.invariant: The normative organization control-plane profile declares exactly eight credential planes with globally disjoint exact credential kinds; Keycloak client authentication is distinct from human and workload access-token authority; every operation has exact per-plane caller-role alternatives, an exact forbidden or required downstream provider-effect mode, and an exact optional provider-evidence receipt profile; pure validation performs no provider I/O while activation performs the mandatory current reviewer-permission recheck; omission enablement excludes emergency authority and requires both activate and override while emergency safety requires no Keycloak role; production break-glass permits exactly force FullCI and disable omission; one exact GitHub App identity and a read-only current permission profile are normative while every write profile remains deferred; the App private key and reviewer OAuth client secret have distinct exact credential kinds, deployment custody, and bounded rotation procedures; browser sessions are bounded to at most 900 seconds and retain no Keycloak bearer; repository attestation is independent from Keycloak; and live observations remain non-authorizing.
nonClaims: Profile consistency does not implement identity, configure external providers, execute witnesses, or grant production authority.

requirements.invariant: Administrator Activity records admitted session insertions and actual lifecycle deletions atomically with their database transaction. Required journal failure rolls back the session change. Optional rejection, role-denial and export diagnostics are bounded and cannot invent committed effects or caller identity. Anonymous diagnostics atomically clean bounded expired hourly buckets and increment their saturating counter without acquiring the ordered journal mutex or deleting activity events. Principal diagnostics and required session effects retain their ordered journal authority; existing maintenance retains full cleanup. Issuer-authorized security pages and independently repository-authorized business-reference pages remain separate, filtered, finite, no-store and continuation-bound to the current principal, profile, query and source watermark. Reads enforce retention before cleanup; physical cleanup is bounded and scheduled. The forward capability, exact schema and least-privilege runtime grants are admitted before Activity SQL. Source, identity, temporal, quota and transaction operands have independent native falsifiers.
nonClaims: This activity projection is not all request history, business-chain verification, IdP event collection, export delivery, native acceptance, Swarm log retention or production qualification.
